_comment: use_ranks: ranks the user must stand in. target: enemy | ally | self | party. target_ranks: ranks that can be targeted. aoe: hits every valid target. dmg: damage modifier (-0.5 = 50% of weapon damage). Effects: bleed, poison, stun, mark, debuff, buff, random_buff, heal, heal_pct, fatigue, knockback, pull, guard, taunt, cure, clear_shaken, light. self_effects apply to the user: move (+forward/-back), summon, heal_self_pct and any effect above.

marshal_iron_justice.name: Iron Justice
marshal_iron_justice.desc: A point-blank revolver shot, delivered with the full weight of the law. Bonus against outlaws (growing with each level), and more against Marked targets.

marshal_pistol_whip.name: Pistol-Whip
marshal_pistol_whip.desc: Cracks a revolver butt across a skull. Stuns.

marshal_deputize.name: Deputize
marshal_deputize.desc: Steps in to shield an ally: attacks aimed at them hit the Marshal instead. The Marshal gains Protection.

marshal_warrant.name: Serve a Warrant
marshal_warrant.desc: Names the target a wanted outlaw: Marked, and easier to hit.

marshal_hold_the_line.name: Hold the Line
marshal_hold_the_line.desc: Plants their boots. Taunts enemies into attacking the Marshal, gains Protection and sheds Fatigue.

marshal_warning_shot.name: Weighted Shot
marshal_warning_shot.desc: A heavy-loaded round that hits like a mule's kick. Knocks the target back 2 ranks.

marshal_flash_badge.name: Flash the Badge
marshal_flash_badge.desc: "By the authority of the Territory!" Shakes an ally free: clears stuns and every debuff, patches them up a little, and hurries them along.

marshal_ap_ammo.name: Armor-Piercing Rounds
marshal_ap_ammo.desc: Thumbs steel-jacketed rounds into the cylinder. Attacks ignore 20% of the target's Protection.

mm_axe_cleave.name: Axe Cleave
mm_axe_cleave.desc: A wide swing of a felling axe that catches both front ranks and splits their guard. Vulnerable for a round.

mm_grizzly_chop.name: Grizzly Chop
mm_grizzly_chop.desc: An overhead chop. Much stronger when the Mystic is below half health.

mm_gnarl.name: Gnarl at the Flesh
mm_gnarl.desc: Bites into their own arm and melts back into the trees: moves back 2, bleeds, and is hard to hit for a round.

mm_bear_trap.name: Bear Trap
mm_bear_trap.desc: Kicks a sprung trap into the brush; it snaps shut on whoever steps there. Bleed and Slow.

mm_piece_of_me.name: Take a Piece of Me
mm_piece_of_me.desc: Old mountain medicine paid in the Mystic's own blood: heals an ally and hardens them against bleeding and venom.

mm_bellow.name: Bellow
mm_bellow.desc: A roar from deep in the trees. Lowers all enemies' Accuracy, but it takes something out of the Mystic.

mm_shadows.name: From the Shadows
mm_shadows.desc: Steps out of the tree line swinging: moves forward 2 and gains Crit and Damage.

mm_jerky.name: Edible Meat
mm_jerky.desc: Best not to ask what it is. Heals and cures Bleed and Poison.

rd_hammer_blow.name: Hammerfell
rd_hammer_blow.desc: The whole nine pounds, straight down. Knocks the target back. Bonus against Marked targets.

rd_spike_drive.name: Rain of Nails
rd_spike_drive.desc: Swings a keg of railroad spikes into the second line. Slows.

rd_rhythm.name: Hammered Rhythm
rd_rhythm.desc: Finds the work song's beat. Gains Damage and Speed.

rd_line_breaker.name: Line Breaker
rd_line_breaker.desc: A sweeping swing that shoves the front two enemies back.

rd_brace.name: Brace Yourselves!
rd_brace.desc: Sets their feet and bellows for the enemy to come at them. Gains Protection, heals a little, and Marks themself as the target.

rd_sledge_toss.name: Sledge Toss
rd_sledge_toss.desc: Hurls a spare sledge blind into the enemy line, then steps forward. Rings their bell: Vulnerable.

rd_frenzy.name: Hammer Frenzy
rd_frenzy.desc: Three wild swings at whatever's closest. Leaves them off balance, and the Rail Driver winded (stuns self).

rd_quarrel.name: Quarrel
rd_quarrel.desc: "You want some of this?" Marks the target and cracks its guard.

gs_quick_draw.name: Quick Draw
gs_quick_draw.desc: Clears leather before anyone else can blink. Reaches any rank.

gs_fan.name: Fan the Hammer
gs_fan.desc: Three rapid shots at random enemies.

gs_twin.name: Twin Shots
gs_twin.desc: Both pistols at once, two hits on one target.

gs_point_blank.name: Point Blank
gs_point_blank.desc: Jams the barrel into the enemy's gut, fires, then steps back. Leaves them doubled over: Vulnerable.

gs_duck.name: Duck and Weave
gs_duck.desc: Rolls forward into cover. Gains Dodge.

gs_called_shot.name: Called Shot
gs_called_shot.desc: Takes careful aim. Huge bonus damage against Marked targets.

gs_ap_ammo.name: Armor-Piercing Rounds
gs_ap_ammo.desc: Loads steel-cored rounds. Attacks ignore 15% of the target's Protection.

gs_smoke.name: Smokescreen
gs_smoke.desc: A shot into a powder pouch: a cloud of black smoke. The target is slowed and easier to hit.

wr_sic_em.name: Sic 'Em
wr_sic_em.desc: Biscuit the cattle dog goes for the ankles. Bleed; bonus against Marked targets.

wr_lasso.name: Lasso
wr_lasso.desc: Ropes a back-line enemy and hauls them forward. Pull 2 and Mark.

wr_hogtie.name: Hogtie
wr_hogtie.desc: Ties the enemy up like a calf at branding. Stuns.

wr_bullwhip.name: Crack the Whip
wr_bullwhip.desc: A whip-crack over an ally's head (or their own): get moving! Gains Damage and Speed.

wr_heel.name: Good Boy
wr_heel.desc: Biscuit trots over and leans on someone. Heals a little, and often takes the edge off.

wr_round_up.name: Round 'Em Up
wr_round_up.desc: A drover's whistle that gets everyone moving. The party gains Accuracy.

wr_snarl.name: Snarl
wr_snarl.desc: Biscuit bares every tooth he has at the front line. They back off a step: less Protection and Damage.

wr_light_whip.name: Lightspeed Whip
wr_light_whip.desc: Twenty feet of braided leather that reaches the very back. Bonus against Marked targets.

gb_derringer.name: Ace up the Sleeve
gb_derringer.desc: A pocket pistol from the sleeve, and a steadier hand after.

gb_all_in.name: ALL IN
gb_all_in.desc: Pushes every chip to the middle of the table. Big Damage, Accuracy and Speed, but everyone's watching (Marks self).

gb_card_toss.name: Deal 'Em
gb_card_toss.desc: Deals a hand of razor-edged cards to the whole table. Bleed.

gb_stacked.name: Stacked Deck
gb_stacked.desc: Deals every ally a card: each gets a random boon.

gb_bluff.name: Poker Face
gb_bluff.desc: Gives nothing away. Gains Dodge and Speed.

gb_money_shot.name: Money Shot
gb_money_shot.desc: A shot with a bounty on it; hits harder on a Marked target. A kill pays 30 chips (+10 a level) and the Gambler breathes easier; no kill, and the 10-chip stake is lost.

gb_joker.name: Assign the Joker
gb_joker.desc: Flicks the Joker at a back-liner: Marked, and off their game.

gb_lotto.name: Lotto Ticket
gb_lotto.desc: A one-in-a-hundred shot from the very back. Nearly always misses; when it hits, it's a jackpot. Stack Accuracy to make it pay.

pr_dynamite.name: Dynamite Toss
pr_dynamite.desc: A lit stick lobbed into the enemy's back lines.

pr_pickaxe.name: Pickaxe
pr_pickaxe.desc: Swings the old pick like they're chasing a vein of gold, and chips a hole in their armour. Vulnerable.

pr_blasting_cap.name: Blasting Charge
pr_blasting_cap.desc: A charge with a short fuse, planted on one enemy. May Stun.

pr_flash.name: Flash Powder
pr_flash.desc: A blinding puff of magnesium over the front pair or the back pair. Lowers Accuracy.

pr_lamp.name: Raise the Lamp
pr_lamp.desc: Holds the miner's lamp high. The party gains Dodge and Accuracy; in caves, restores Lamplight.

pr_rock_hammer.name: Depth Charge
pr_rock_hammer.desc: A mining charge rolled into the front line. Huge blast: may Stun and knock back 2.

ss_long_shot.name: Poison Darts
ss_long_shot.desc: Two blowgun darts into the enemy line. Weakens their resistances and Poisons (worse if the user is poisoned too).

ss_sight.name: Gas Cloud
ss_sight.desc: A gourd of swamp gas bursts over the enemy. Lowers Debuff and Poison Resist, and whatever ails them lingers a round longer.

ss_kill_shot.name: Bola Shot
ss_kill_shot.desc: Weighted cords whirl into the middle of the line and tangle both. Stuns.

ss_suppress.name: Suppressing Fire
ss_suppress.desc: A spray of darts across the front of the line. Slows.

ss_sacrament.name: Blighted Sacrament
ss_sacrament.desc: A thorn dipped in the worst of the bayou. Heavy Poison; hits much harder if the user is poisoned.

ss_mushroom.name: Questionable Mushroom
ss_mushroom.desc: Something off a log, good for what ails you. Mostly. Heals one of the company (or the Poisoner) and sheds Fatigue, with a small chance of a light poison.

ss_frog.name: Sticky Frog
ss_frog.desc: Lobs a very unhappy tree frog. Whoever it lands on can't see straight or step lively.

dr_dart.name: Flask of Vileness
dr_dart.desc: A flask of something vile, uncorked in the back line. Strong Poison.

dr_caustic.name: Experimental Tonic
dr_caustic.desc: Untested, but promising. Heals a little, may ease or add Fatigue, and gives a Damage boost.

dr_surgery.name: Battlefield Surgery
dr_surgery.desc: Quick, bloody, effective, and the patient goes under for it. A big heal and cures Bleed and Poison, but they're Stunned and left weak for a while (less Protection).

dr_salts.name: Smelling Salts
dr_salts.desc: Snaps an ally back to their senses. Cures Stun, Bleed and Poison, and gains Speed.

dr_chloroform.name: Chloroform Rag
dr_chloroform.desc: A soaked rag over the mouth. Stuns.

dr_laudanum.name: Laudanum
dr_laudanum.desc: A few drops take the edge off. Big Fatigue relief, but the patient is slow and sluggish.

pc_hands.name: Laying On of Hands
pc_hands.desc: A prayer and a firm hand. A strong single heal.

pc_revival.name: Revival Meeting
pc_revival.desc: Leads the company in a hymn. Heals everyone a little.

pc_sermon.name: Sermon on the Trail
pc_sermon.desc: Words of comfort for weary souls. Party sheds Fatigue and gains Accuracy.

pc_brimstone.name: Fire and Brimstone
pc_brimstone.desc: Lifts the brass lantern and blazes holy light. May Stun.

pc_smite.name: Righteous Smite
pc_smite.desc: Brings the good book down hard: laid bare before the Lord. Vulnerable; extra damage against mythic creatures.

pc_hellfire.name: Hellfire Sermon
pc_hellfire.desc: Thunders about the fire to come. Every enemy loses Accuracy and Damage, and the unnatural can't shut it out. Costs the Preacher some Fatigue.

pc_baptism.name: Baptism in the River
pc_baptism.desc: Plunges the wicked under. Washes away every boon on the target and leaves it Soaked: slower and easier to hit. Mythic creatures may be stunned outright.

dr_transfusion.name: Transfusion
dr_transfusion.desc: A long needle into an enemy, and the blood goes to whoever needs it most: heals your most wounded ally for 150% of the damage dealt.

dr_scalpel.name: Scalpel Toss
dr_scalpel.desc: A flicked scalpel, placed exactly where it hurts. Bleeds, and a surgeon's eye finds the weak spot more often than most.

pc_judgment.name: Book of Judgment
pc_judgment.desc: Reads a verse of judgment aloud over the named sinner. Lowers the target's Damage; extra damage against Marked targets and mythic creatures.

e_gunhand_shot.name: Double Tap
e_gunhand_shot.desc: Two quick pistol shots at whoever is closest to hand.

e_gunhand_pin.name: Pinning Fire
e_gunhand_pin.desc: Shots that keep your head down.

e_rifle_snipe.name: Snipe
e_rifle_snipe.desc: A careful rifle shot at the back line.

e_rifle_volley.name: Skeet Shot
e_rifle_volley.desc: Rapid rifle fire sprayed down the whole line.

e_rifle_haymaker.name: Haymaker
e_rifle_haymaker.desc: Caught up close, a rifleman still has fists.

e_fallback_swing.name: Desperate Swing
e_fallback_swing.desc: Out of position, it lashes out with whatever is at hand.

e_tut_stab.name: Clumsy Stab
e_tut_stab.desc: A looter's knife, held like a fork.

e_tut_shot.name: Wild Shot
e_tut_shot.desc: A greenhorn's pistol shot, eyes half shut.

e_pete_crowbar.name: Crowbar
e_pete_crowbar.desc: The same bar he opened the fort's crates with.

e_pete_flour.name: Sack of Flour
e_pete_flour.desc: A whole sack of the fort's flour, right in the face.

e_knife_slash.name: Cutthroat Slash
e_knife_slash.desc: A quick knife across the arm, then pressing in.

e_knife_stab.name: Rusty Shank
e_knife_stab.desc: A rusty blade for whoever is bleeding worst.

e_wolf_howl.name: Howl for the Pack
e_wolf_howl.desc: A howl that raises the hair on your neck and rallies the pack.

e_snake_rattle.name: Rattle
e_snake_rattle.desc: The dry buzz every traveler dreads.

e_crow_eyes.name: Carrion Dive
e_crow_eyes.desc: The flock dives at the weakest face in the line.

e_crow_circle.name: Circle the Drain
e_crow_circle.desc: The flock wheels overhead, waiting. Hard to aim with that going on.

e_coyote_yip.name: Feral Yipping
e_coyote_yip.desc: The whole pack yips at once.

e_haint_wail.name: Ghost of the Past
e_haint_wail.desc: A voice from the tall grass that sounds like someone you lost.

e_lt_shotgun.name: Blunderbuss
e_lt_shotgun.desc: Both barrels into the front line.

e_mull_haymaker.name: Ham-Fist Haymaker
e_mull_haymaker.desc: A fist like a ham hock. It rings bells.

e_mull_bottle.name: Busted Bottle
e_mull_bottle.desc: The jagged end of a whiskey bottle.

e_jeb_cavein.name: Cave-In
e_jeb_cavein.desc: Old Jeb knocks twice on the ceiling, and the ceiling answers.

e_ruby_knives.name: Fan of Knives
e_ruby_knives.desc: Three throwing knives from one sleeve.

e_ruby_commune.name: Dark Commune
e_ruby_commune.desc: Ruby presses the crow feather to her lips and whispers. Something whispers back.

e_crane_fan.name: Crane's Fusillade
e_crane_fan.desc: Silas empties both revolvers down the line.

e_crane_dead_aim.name: Dead Aim
e_crane_dead_aim.desc: A slow, deliberate shot at the weakest link.

e_crane_storm.name: Crowstorm
e_crane_storm.desc: Silas raises his arms and the sky over the bridge turns black with wings.

e_crane_call.name: Murder of Crows
e_crane_call.desc: Silas whistles, and the sky goes black with wings.

e_cj_dirt.name: Kick Up Dust
e_cj_dirt.desc: A boot heel's worth of grit in the eyes.

e_rr_eviction.name: Notice of Eviction
e_rr_eviction.desc: Waves company paper in your face.

e_dyn_throw.name: Lit Fuse
e_dyn_throw.desc: A stick of dynamite tossed with a grin.

e_siren_song.name: Canyon Song
e_siren_song.desc: A voice that makes you want to lie down and never get up.

e_siren_lure.name: Lure
e_siren_lure.desc: Draws a hero forward toward the cliff's edge.

e_gila_bite.name: Locking Bite
e_gila_bite.desc: Bites down and won't let go.

e_hired_gun_mark.name: Paid in Advance
e_hired_gun_mark.desc: Picks a target and lets everyone know.

e_cyc_club.name: Tree-Trunk Club
e_cyc_club.desc: The Cyclops sweeps a whole pine tree through the line.

e_cyc_boulder.name: Hurled Boulder
e_cyc_boulder.desc: A boulder the size of a wagon, thrown at the back line.

e_cyc_glare.name: The Great Eye
e_cyc_glare.desc: A single eye the size of a wagon wheel turns toward you.

e_cyc_call.name: Call the Flock
e_cyc_call.desc: The shepherd whistles for his stone rams.

e_bandit_blade.name: Bowie Knife
e_bandit_blade.desc: A long knife and a short temper.

e_grizzly_roar.name: Grizzly Roar
e_grizzly_roar.desc: You feel it in your teeth.

e_hawk_dive.name: Thunder Dive
e_hawk_dive.desc: Drops out of the storm at the back line.

e_wight_chill.name: Frostbite
e_wight_chill.desc: Ice creeps up from the fingertips.

e_wight_whisper.name: Snowblind Whisper
e_wight_whisper.desc: It tells you to lie down in the snow and rest.

e_giant_rock.name: Rock Throw
e_giant_rock.desc: A young stone giant hurls a chunk of mountain.

e_giant_stomp.name: Earthshaker
e_giant_stomp.desc: The ground bucks like a wild horse.

e_titan_sweep.name: Mountain's Arm
e_titan_sweep.desc: An arm of granite sweeps the pass clean.

e_titan_quake.name: Quake
e_titan_quake.desc: The Titan stamps, and the mountain answers.

e_titan_voice.name: Voice of the Mountain
e_titan_voice.desc: It speaks, and it is older than anything you know.

e_titan_call.name: Call the Storm
e_titan_call.desc: Thunderheads gather and storm hawks pour out of them.

e_titan_crush.name: Crushing Grip
e_titan_crush.desc: Picks up one of you. Squeezes.

e_bat_screech.name: Screech
e_bat_screech.desc: A sound too high to hear but not too high to feel.

e_knocker_knock.name: Knock, Knock
e_knocker_knock.desc: Tapping in the walls. Tapping behind you.

e_knocker_pick.name: Oversized Pick
e_knocker_pick.desc: A full-size miner's pick swung by a very small, very angry miner. It takes a moment to recover.

e_crawler_grab.name: Pale Grasp
e_crawler_grab.desc: Cold hands out of the dark.

e_crawler_horrors.name: Horrors from Beyond
e_crawler_horrors.desc: It opens its mouth, and the dark behind it opens too.

th_boxcar_leap.name: Boxcar Leap
th_boxcar_leap.desc: Takes a running jump across the gap between cars: moves forward 1 and comes down swinging.

th_stowaway.name: Stowaway
th_stowaway.desc: Ducks into an empty boxcar for a breather: moves back 1, patches up a little and stops any Bleeding.

th_chart_hills.name: Chart the Hills
th_chart_hills.desc: Reads the lie of the land and chalks a hobo sign for the company: the target is Marked. Moves forward 1.

th_railspike.name: Railspike Toss
th_railspike.desc: A pried-loose railroad spike, thrown hard: the target is Vulnerable. Moves forward 1.

th_emergency_brake.name: Emergency Brake
th_emergency_brake.desc: Throws the brake and lets the train go on without her: moves back 2, gains Dodge and shakes off every debuff.

th_dancing_man.name: The Dancing Man
th_dancing_man.desc: Hops and jigs on the car roof, daring them to try: Marks herself, gains Dodge, and moves forward 1.

th_ride_rods.name: Ride the Rods
th_ride_rods.desc: Slips under the front line the way she rides under a freight car, strikes whoever's behind it, then rolls back 1.

th_catch_out.name: Catch Out
th_catch_out.desc: Catches a departing train to reach a friend: swaps places with any ally, who gains Protection.

th_end_of_line.name: End of the Line
th_end_of_line.desc: Spends every scrap of Momentum on one blow from any rank: huge damage, more against a Marked target, and it ignores half their Protection. She lands in rank 1. A kill gives back 20 Momentum.
